Test Case: With an active segment use Markup > Text Quick Note
Expected Result: Note editor opens; entered text saves and displays with the segment

Test Case: Edit an existing quick note's text
Expected Result: Updated text saves and renders

Test Case: Delete a quick note (click into note then Delete toolbar button)
Expected Result: Note is removed; segment is unaffected

Test Case: Use Connect menu > Quick Note Above / Below / Right / Left
Expected Result: Note moves to the chosen side of its anchor

Test Case: Use Set Quick Note Position modal with a custom value
Expected Result: Note repositions per the entered value

Test Case: Use Reset Quick Note Position
Expected Result: Note returns to default position

Test Case: Use Set Quick Note Offset modal
Expected Result: Note offsets per the entered value; Reset Quick Note Offset restores default

Test Case: Use Set Quick Note Slide modal
Expected Result: Note slides along its axis per value; Reset Quick Note Slide restores default

Test Case: Select two segments and use Connect menu > Connect
Expected Result: A connection line is drawn between the segments

Test Case: Create connections of each available type
Expected Result: Each type renders with distinct styling

Test Case: Click a connection line
Expected Result: Connection becomes active/selected with visible styling

Test Case: Select an active connection and click Delete in the toolbar
Expected Result: Connection is removed

Test Case: Create a cross-item connection (across columns/sections)
Expected Result: Connection renders correctly across the items

Test Case: Add a Connection Quick Note via Connect menu
Expected Result: Note attaches to the connection and displays

Test Case: Edit and delete a connection note
Expected Result: Edits save; deletion removes only the note

Test Case: Change connection note placement/lead settings
Expected Result: Note placement updates and persists

Test Case: Toggle View > All Connections off and on
Expected Result: All connection lines hide/show

Test Case: Toggle Column / Section / Segment / Cross-Item Connections individually
Expected Result: Only the corresponding connection category hides/shows

Test Case: Resize or restructure content with connections present
Expected Result: Connection lines re-anchor and redraw correctly

Test Case: Select a segment and apply each color from the Color menu
Expected Result: Segment is highlighted in the chosen color

Test Case: Apply color to a section and to a column
Expected Result: Color applies to the whole section/column

Test Case: Re-apply the same color or clear color from an item
Expected Result: Color is removed/toggled as designed

Test Case: Verify Color menu disabled state on Document view with a segment or section active
Expected Result: Color menu is disabled in that case

Test Case: Toggle View > All Quick Notes / Text Quick Notes / Connection Quick Notes
Expected Result: Corresponding notes hide/show independently

Test Case: Add notes / connections / colors then reload
Expected Result: All annotations persist exactly

Test Case: View the same study on the Document view
Expected Result: Annotations appear (or are excluded) per the design of that view
